title: Agent record
description: A PreToolUse hook's record of one AskBoard call, sent before the call reaches the session process (AD-5): who makes it (agent_id and agent_type as Claude Code names them, both absent for the main conversation), its working directory, the call's tool_use_id when Claude Code gives one, the tool's name, the ask IDs the call names and when the hook ran.

cwd.description: The agent's working directory, an absolute path.

askIds.description: askId for ask, and every asks[].askId for collect: at most the 40 asks one collect takes.
